get.description: Retrieves accessible document summaries from Affinda.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: compact
parameters.description: If "true", the response is compacted to annotations' parsed data. Annotations' meta data are excluded. Default is "false".

schema.description: If "true", the response is compacted to annotations' parsed data. Annotations' meta data are excluded. Default is "false".

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: If "false", the documents count is not computed, thus saving time for large collections. Default is "true".

schema.description: If "false", the documents count is not computed, thus saving time for large collections. Default is "true".

parameters.name: customIdentifier
parameters.description: Filter for documents with this custom identifier.

schema.description: Filter for documents with this custom identifier.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Exclude some documents from the result.

schema.description: Exclude some documents from the result.

parameters.name: includeData
parameters.description: By default, this endpoint returns only the meta data of the documents. Set this to `true` will return a summary of the data that was parsed. If you want to retrieve the full set of data for a document, use the `GET /documents/{identifier}` endpoint.

schema.description: By default, this endpoint returns only the meta data of the documents. Set this to `true` will return a summary of the data that was parsed. If you want to retrieve the full set of data for a document, use the `GET /documents/{identifier}` endpoint.

parameters.name: inReview
parameters.description: Exclude documents that are currently being reviewed.

schema.description: Exclude documents that are currently being reviewed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The numbers of results to return.

schema.description: The numbers of results to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of documents to skip before starting to collect the result set.

schema.description: The number of documents to skip before starting to collect the result set.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Sort the result set. A "-" at the beginning denotes DESC sort, e.g. -created_dt. Sort by multiple fields is supported. Supported values include: 'file_name', 'extractor', 'created_dt', 'validated_dt', 'archived_dt' and 'parsed__<dataPointSlug>'.

schema.description: Sort the result set. A "-" at the beginning denotes DESC sort, e.g. -created_dt. Sort by multiple fields is supported. Supported values include: 'file_name', 'extractor', 'created_dt', 'validated_dt', 'archived_dt' and 'parsed__<dataPointSlug>'.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Partial, case-insensitive match with file name or tag name.

schema.description: Partial, case-insensitive match with file name or tag name.

parameters.name: snakeCase
parameters.description: Whether to return the response in snake_case instead of camelCase. Default is false.

schema.description: Whether to return the response in snake_case instead of camelCase. Default is false.
